text_en: [0C][05][14][01][01]"They say a dragon or[01]something's supposed[01]to appear tonight...[0B][02]So we were told to[01]watch this area."
[0C][05][14][01][01]"That's right--and[01]not just any dragon,[01]either![02]They say it's the[01]legendary Dragon of[01]Doom,[02]which will bring[01]ruin to the Empire!"
[0C][06][14][82]B"Thou believest thou[01]can do such a thing?[02]Thou art but mere[01]mortals."
[0C][05][14][C6]@"Thou dost not ken[01]the power of that[02]which you would[01]destroy.[02]This be a dragon."

[0C][03][14][C6]@"A dragon 'tis[01]force of nature[01]unto itself.[02]Thou mayest as well[01]seek to fight a[02]volcano or the[01]very earth itself![02]Dragons doth give[01]birth to thy kind,[02]grant thee life,[01]and verily taketh[01]it away.[02]They are to thee[01]as thou art to an[01]insect.[02]In thy terms...[0B]"
[14][83]C"'Tis as I thought...[02]It is not the nature[01]of mortals to change[01]their ways...[0B]"
